cases.sentence: Основатель церкви дает наставление членам церкви. Итак, принимайте нас как служителей Христа, которым были вверены тайны ___.
cases.translation: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants, and stewards of God's mysteries.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession - mysteries belonging to God.

cases.sentence: От тех, кому оказано такое доверие, требуется ___.
cases.translation: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used as the predicate after 'требуется' (is required).

cases.sentence: Меня очень мало заботят, как вы или кто-то другой будет обо мне ___.
cases.translation: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you.
cases.explain: The infinitive form is used after the verb 'заботят' (worry).

cases.sentence: Совесть моя чиста, хотя не это оправдывает ___.
cases.translation: For I know nothing against myself.
cases.explain: The accusative object of 'оправдывает' (justifies) here appears as genitive.

cases.sentence: Но мой судья — Господь, поэтому ни о чем не судите заранее, но ждите возвращения ___.
cases.translation: But he who judges me is the Lord, therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the preposition 'до' (until) for 'возвращения' (return/coming).

cases.sentence: Я говорю это, братья, обо мне и об Аполлосе, ради вашего ___, чтобы вы на нашем примере постигли.
cases.translation: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes.
cases.explain: The preposition 'ради' (for the sake of) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Потому что мне кажется, что Бог выставил нас, апостолов, как последних из людей, как осужденных на смертную казнь, на всеобщее ___.
cases.translation: For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death.
cases.explain: The nominative form completes the prepositional phrase 'на всеобщее обозрение' (for public view).

cases.sentence: Когда нас проклинают, мы в ответ ___.
cases.translation: When people curse us, we bless.
cases.explain: The present tense first person plural form 'благословляем' (we bless) is used as the predicate.

reading.ru: Итак, принимайте нас как служителей Христа, которым были вверены тайны Божии.
reading.question: How should the Corinthians regard Paul and his companions?
options: As servants of Christ and stewards of God's mysteries
reading.correct: As servants of Christ and stewards of God's mysteries
reading.explain: Paul says 'принимайте нас как служителей Христа, которым были вверены тайны Божии' — let a man think of us as Christ's servants, and stewards of God's mysteries.

reading.ru: Совесть моя чиста, хотя не это оправдывает меня, но мой судья — Господь.
reading.question: What does Paul say about his conscience and justification?
options: His conscience is clear but only the Lord truly judges him
His conscience condemns him and he deserves judgment
He doesn't need any judge since he is righteous
His conscience is guilty of many crimes
reading.correct: His conscience is clear but only the Lord truly judges him
reading.explain: Paul states 'Совесть моя чиста, хотя не это оправдывает меня, но мой судья — Господь' — I know nothing against myself, yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

reading.ru: Хотя у вас тысячи учителей во Христе, у вас все же немного отцов.
reading.question: What does Paul say about teachers and fathers in the church?
options: There are many teachers but few fathers
There are no teachers at all
There are many fathers but no teachers
Teachers and fathers are the same thing
reading.correct: There are many teachers but few fathers
reading.explain: Paul writes 'Хотя у вас тысячи учителей во Христе, у вас все же немного отцов' — Though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don't have many fathers.

reading.ru: Я же стал вашим отцом через радостную весть об Иисусе Христе.
reading.question: What is Paul's relationship to the Corinthians?
options: He is their spiritual father through the gospel of Jesus Christ
He is their enemy and critic
He is a stranger to them
reading.correct: He is their spiritual father through the gospel of Jesus Christ
reading.explain: Paul says 'Я же стал вашим отцом через радостную весть об Иисусе Христе' — I became your father through the Good News in Christ Jesus.

reading.ru: Для этого я и посылаю к вам Тимофея, моего дорогого и верного сына в Господе.
reading.question: Who does Paul send to the Corinthians and why?
options: Timothy, his beloved and faithful son in the Lord
reading.correct: Timothy, his beloved and faithful son in the Lord
reading.explain: Paul says 'я и посылаю к вам Тимофея, моего дорогого и верного сына в Господе' — I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord.

reading.ru: Некоторые из вас возгордились, полагая, что я не приду к вам, но я скоро приду к вам, если на то будет воля Господа.
reading.question: What does Paul say about coming to the Corinthians?
options: He will come soon if the Lord wills, despite their arrogance
He will never return to Corinth
He sends a permanent replacement instead
He is too busy to visit them
reading.correct: He will come soon if the Lord wills, despite their arrogance
reading.explain: Paul says 'я скоро приду к вам, если на то будет воля Господа' — I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing.
